apps.name: Last Wave
apps.subtitle: Your YouTube Music library, mixed like a DJ
apps.localizedDescription:
A native iPhone music player for your YouTube Music library, built in the style of Apple Music. Your playlists, likes and history come from your YouTube Music account; Last Wave adds DJ-style Automix with tempo matching, synced word-by-word lyrics, search by lyrics, offline downloads, Last.fm scrobbling and playlist import from Spotify and Apple Music.

Three interfaces: Classic (iOS 18), Liquid Glass (iOS 26) and Liquid Glass+ (iOS 27 and later). Requires iOS 18 or later and a YouTube Music account (free is fine).

Independent and non-commercial. Not affiliated with Google, YouTube, Spotify, Apple or Last.fm.
